full_judgment: 7. The trial Court dismissed the suit and on an appeal the lower appellate Court allowed the same. Against the aforesaid judgment of reversal the defendant No. 5, the leave petitioner, preferred revision case before the High Court Division and the learned Single Judge discharged the Rule. Hence this leave petition.
